title: Scalar endomorphisms act on the affine unit germ by their germs
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], x in an affine open U, A = Gamma(X,U), R = O_{X,x}, and H, b and mu_a as in [def-sc-affine-free-basis-germs]. For every a in A, H(mu_a)(b) = germ_U,x(a) b.

source.place: Tag 01HV, Lemma 26.5.4 (7), natural associated-sheaf stalk localization; Tag 01IB, affine module sheafification; Tag 01C6, finite free sheaves; Tag 0098, restriction along the affine chart; direct-image stalk computed on the cofinal neighbourhoods contained in U

proof.text: Unfold the explicit regular unit germ and the composite stalk functor. The stalk-map-on-germs identity rewrites the image as the germ of the sectionwise image. Apply the scalar section action to that section and PresheafOfModules.germ_smul to identify its germ with germ(a) times the unit germ.

theorem affineRegularStalkGerm_scalar
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (x : X) (U : X.Opens) (hxU : x ∈ U) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (a : Γ(X, U)) :
    (affineFreeStalkFunctor X x U hU).map (affineScalarEnd X U a)
        (affineRegularStalkGerm X x U hxU hU) =
      X.presheaf.germ U x hxU a • affineRegularStalkGerm X x U hxU hU
